name: owned root
wording: everything cratylus places on a host lives under one root it alone owns, which the harness's own surfaces only refer into, so what cratylus placed is known, never guessed; upgrade and uninstall keep nothing changed inside the root and everything the host placed or changed outside it, removing only cratylus's references into the root.
